##Heatmaps
```{r}
# Load necessary data 
RESULT_PATH <- "../result_human"
COLUMN_PREFIX <- "gfp"
P_VALUE_FILTER <- 0.01
load(file.path(RESULT_PATH, "DESeq2_results.RData"))
load(file.path(RESULT_PATH, "TPM_results.RData"))
genes_of_interest <- read.csv(file.path(RESULT_PATH, "prolonged_gene_list.csv"))

```

###All significant genes
```{r}
# Log-transform the TPM values. 
log_tpm_matrix <- log2(tpm_filtered + 1)

# Using pheatmap to plot the heatmap of the significant genes

# Add gene_names and select names from all genes list (g2s)
log_tpm_matrix_gene_names <- log_tpm_matrix %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% merge(g2s)

# Extract the only column from filtered_genes as a vector for easier manipulation
filtered_genes_vector <- filtered_genes[[1]]

# Filter to significant genes object called sig_log_tpm_matrix
sig_log_tpm_matrix <- log_tpm_matrix_gene_names[log_tpm_matrix_gene_names$gene_name %in% filtered_genes_vector, ]

# Remove all observations with missing data (NA)
sig_log_tpm_matrix <- na.omit(sig_log_tpm_matrix)

# Remove non numeric data for plotting heatmap
sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric <- sig_log_tpm_matrix %>% select(-gene_id, -gene_name)
sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric <- sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric[apply(sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric, 1, function(x) var(x) != 0), ]

# Setting custom clustering and distance functions
custom_dist <- function(x) dist(x, method = "euclidean") 
custom_hclust <- function(x) hclust(x, method = "ward.D2") 

# Set the scale
breaks <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 51)

# Plot heatmap for log transformed significant genes using custom clustering and distance methods, and breaks
pheatmap(sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric, 
         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
         cluster_cols = TRUE,  
         scale = "row",        
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = TRUE,  
         main = "Heatmap of Log2-Transformed TPM Values for All Significant Genes",
         distfun = custom_dist,
         hclustfun = custom_hclust,
         treeheight_row = 0,   
         color = colorRampPalette(c("purple", "white", "yellow"))(50),
         breaks = breaks,
         filename = file.path(RESULT_PATH,"heatmap_all_sig_genes_log_tpm.png"))

save(log_tpm_matrix_gene_names, sig_log_tpm_matrix, sig_log_tpm_matrix_numeric,
     file = file.path(RESULT_PATH, "heatmap_datasets.RData"))

```

###Prolonged gene list 

```{r}
# Extract prolonged gene list from previously log transformed and filtered data 
prolonged_sig_genes <- sig_log_tpm_matrix[sig_log_tpm_matrix$gene_name %in% genes_of_interest$gene_name, ]

# Remove all observations with missing data (NA) 
prolonged_sig_genes <- na.omit(prolonged_sig_genes)

# Remove non numeric data for plotting heatmap
prolonged_sig_genes_numeric <- prolonged_sig_genes %>% select(-gene_id, -gene_name)

# Set rownames as the gene names to be able to visualize them in the heatmap
rownames(prolonged_sig_genes_numeric) <- prolonged_sig_genes$gene_name

# Setting custom clustering and distance functions
custom_dist <- function(x) dist(x, method = "euclidean") 
custom_hclust <- function(x) hclust(x, method = "ward.D2") 

# Set the scale
breaks <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 51)

# Plot heatmap for log transformed significant genes using custom clustering and distance methods, and breaks
pheatmap(prolonged_sig_genes_numeric, 
         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
         cluster_cols = TRUE,  
         scale = "row",        
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = TRUE,  
         main = "Heatmap of Log2-Transformed TPM Values of Prolonged Genes",
         distfun = custom_dist,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("purple", "white", "yellow"))(50),
         hclustfun = custom_hclust,
         breaks = breaks,
        filename = file.path(RESULT_PATH,"heatmap_prolonged_sig_genes_log_tpm.png"))


```
